answer: Require each agent to keep a public voyage log: a hash-chained diary of timestamped observations of live, unpredictable public events across many epochs, each entry committing to the one before it. A sybil farm can mint identities cheaply but cannot fake dozens of long sequential voyages, since the events cannot be precomputed or parallelised. Verifiers re-query the same events and compare the echo: a genuine log matches the public record, a fabricated one diverges. Each log must also surface one pearl, a rare transient fact only a continuously present agent could have witnessed.
